scope: Qt-free metadata identities and validated in-memory snapshots; partial issue coverage
verified_behaviors: Typed track/clip/scene IDs survive rename and snapshot reconstruction
Duplicates allocate fresh identities and preserve ownership/scene mappings under the declared copy policy
Track/clip deletion removes dependent slots and preserves surviving entities
Invalid edits and snapshots preserve the complete prior state, including the ID cursor
Restoring older content retains the allocation high-water mark; deleted identities are not reused by subsequent allocation
Zero/colliding/stale IDs, unknown kinds, invalid names/owners/slots and capacity violations are rejected
ID exhaustion partway through scene duplication rolls back the candidate
Document target and tests build without Qt/PipeWire in the engine-only preset
limits: Single control or worker owner only; operations allocate and copy metadata
Clips contain identity/ownership metadata only, without media or note payloads
No file codec, desktop model adoption, Undo integration or general project migration
No live engine mutation, stuck-note, scene scheduling or asset-retirement qualification
Native UI, physical audio and release qualification remain open
Issue #26 remains open pending persistence and integration evidence
